title: Revisiting Energy-based Tabular Anomaly Detection: Energy and Reconstruction are Complementary
abstract: arXiv:2608.14186v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular anomaly detection is dominated by classical density-proxy methods (Isolation Forest, OCSVM, LOF), reconstruction-based detectors (Autoencoders, VAEs), and modern non-parametric scorers (COPOD, ECOD, Deep SVDD), all of which approximate the inlier distribution only indirectly; explicit energy-based models are largely absent. Motivated by the recent revival of EBMs in deep learning (e.g., Energy-Based Transformers, JEPA), we revisit the classical Deep Boltzmann Machine (DBM) for this task and hypothesize that its mean-field energy combines more effectively with a reconstruction-based score than same-lineage pairs do. We evaluate a two-hidden-layer DBM on two tabular benchmarks spanning distinct domains (UCI Bank Marketing and NSL-KDD) against eight classical and modern baselines across twenty random seeds. translated_title: 重新审视基于能量的表格异常检测：能量与重构具有互补性
translated_abstract: 表格异常检测主要由经典的密度代理方法（如孤立森林、OCSVM、LOF）、基于重构的检测器（自编码器、VAEs）以及现代非参数评分器（COPOD、ECOD、Deep SVDD）主导，这些方法都仅间接近似内部分布；显式基于能量的模型在很大程度上缺失。受深度学习中能量模型近期复兴的启发（例如，基于能量的变换器、JEPA），我们重新审视经典的深度玻尔兹曼机（DBM）用于此任务，并假设其平均场能量与基于重构的评分结合时，比同源组合更有效。我们在两个涵盖不同领域的表格基准数据集（UCI银行营销和NSL-KDD）上，对二十个随机种子下的八个经典和现代基线模型进行了两层隐藏层DBM的评估。DBM的平均场能量在银行营销数据集上与最强基线（自编码器）相当，并在NSL-KDD上统计上优于它。
tldr: 本文提出深度玻尔兹曼机的平均场能量与重构评分结合，在表格异常检测中优于同源基线，表现出能量与重构的互补性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes that combining Deep Boltzmann Machine mean-field energy with reconstruction scores outperforms same-lineage baselines in tabular anomaly detection, demonstrating the complementarity of energy and reconstruction.
